Hello, 
 
I have a question that I have not been able to find the answer to in the references. I obtained abundance estimates for several species using the occupancy model of Royle and Nichols (2003) in MARK, but now I am using Unmarked. This is data for ungulates  obtained from camera trapping.  In most cases, I obtain relatively similar estimates between the two packages, in others similar estimates but very different standard errors and for some other species and/or surveys, the estimates of abundance are very different. For one survey with sparse data, the models in MARK did not converge satisfactorily (I obtained unlikely estimates and standard errors) but they did so in Unmarked. From what I have read, both packages run the mixture model described in the Royle and Nichols 2003 and I cannot find anything that explains if the algorithms or model expressions differ in any way between the two packages. What are potential reasons for the difference in estimates and standard errors between the two packages? Thanks. 
 
Jose
